predicateDefinitions.selection: Require an explicitly enabled, supported and matching exceptional-review rule for this particular offering/work, with a named reason and responsible actor. RECEIVED/REQUESTED alone is insufficient. Automatic source confirmation is the normal path. Unknown stock, out-of-stock or connection failure never creates this review. At as_of select distinct current authoritative workflow_work identities whose latest confirmed state is one of RECEIVED. Merchant acceptance/decline is pending. Require an owner-confirmed currently permitted next action for the viewing actor/location. Another party waiting alone is not an action for this actor. Deduplicate multiple permitted actions on one work_id. Superseded facts are replaced; absent/stale facts are unresolved, not zero.

At as_of select distinct current authoritative workflow_work identities whose latest confirmed state is one of ACCEPTED, ALLOCATED, PICKING, PREPARING, READY_FOR_HANDOVER, AWAITING_CUSTOMER_COLLECTION, HANDED_TO_CARRIER, IN_TRANSIT. One order counts once across preparation/collection/delivery variants. Superseded facts are replaced; absent/stale facts are unresolved, not zero.

Bind registered completed_orders v1.0.0 exactly. Population: Distinct order_id authoritatively confirmed WF_ORDER COMPLETED in period. Date basis: authoritative terminal-state confirmation_at. Preserve registered denominator, exclusions, unit and source events; this is not a new formula.

Select distinct accepted contracted_collection_or_delivery milestone identities attached to work in ACCEPTED, ALLOCATED, PICKING, PREPARING, READY_FOR_HANDOVER, AWAITING_CUSTOMER_COLLECTION, HANDED_TO_CARRIER, IN_TRANSIT. Deadline precedes as_of and no completion/cancellation of this milestone is confirmed. Unknown source never proves missed completion.
